nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Chuyện vặt hằng ngày · bài tự soạn
L: A
Tuan, it's your turn to do the dishes tonight. I did them yesterday.
B
Seriously? I thought we swapped. I took out the trash on Monday.
A
That was a different week. Look at the chart on the fridge.
B
Ugh, you're right. Okay, I'll do the dishes, but you owe me one.
A
Deal. I'll fold the laundry while you do them.
B
Wait, have you vacuumed the living room? Mom's coming on Saturday.
A
Not yet. I'll do it after dinner. We should also tidy up the kitchen.
B
Good idea. It's a mess in here. Who left this pile of clothes on the sofa?
A
That's yours, lazybones! Put them away before Mom sees.
B
Okay, okay, I'm on it. Don't be so bossy!

exq.q: Whose turn is it to do the dishes tonight?
exq.why: “it's your turn to do the dishes” (nói với Tuan).
“Look at the chart on the fridge” = bảng ở trên tủ lạnh.

exq.q: What will Hana do while Tuan does the dishes?
exq.why: “I'll fold the laundry while you do them.”
“Mom's coming on Saturday” = thứ Bảy mẹ sang.
